source.note: Hard-coded counts from the live API, by published_year. Same shape as embed_figures.json.

compliance_2025.label: Policy compliance
compliance_2025.info: 4,852 of 6,778 original research articles covered by the policy. Compliant means the full text is in Europe PMC under a CC BY, CC0 or public domain licence, or an approved CC BY-ND licence. Preprints with a CC BY licence also count.

free_to_read_2025.label: Journal articles free to read
free_to_read_2025.info: 9,463 of 9,917 journal articles that anyone can read for free, from the publisher, a repository or as a preprint.

figures.label: Preprints
figures.info: Preprints by Wellcome-funded researchers or Wellcome authors, by publication date.

preprint_growth.source: Yearly is_preprint counts from the live API on 10 Nov 2026. Only completed years are used. 2023 had 3,982, so 2024 was a low year.

hero.label: Data availability statements in 2025
hero.info: Journal articles with a data availability statement, as a share of the journal articles we’ve reviewed for one.

das_share.caption: Share of reviewed journal articles with a data availability statement, by year
das_share.source: has_data_availability_statement over has_checked_data_availability_statement, from the live API on 10 Nov 2026. 2026 is left out because articles are still being reviewed.
